failures.name: LOCATION_LAUNDERING_TRUST_BYPASS
failures.observation: A raw heldout benchmark case copied to an ordinary path was treated as trusted unpartitioned input and became exportable.
failures.root_cause: Non-benchmark trust is inferred from loader path/context instead of an external allowlisted source authority.

failures.name: SELF_AUTHENTICATED_PAYLOAD_DIGEST_RECOMPUTABLE
failures.observation: A materialized dev payload was modified, its embedded SHA-256 recomputed, and the modified payload remained exportable.
failures.root_cause: The payload digest is stored inside the object it authenticates and is not checked against an independent immutable authority.

failures.name: SUITE_IDENTITY_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
failures.observation: Changing benchmark_provenance.suite_id and recomputing the embedded digest did not block export.
failures.root_cause: Exporter authenticates family manifest/source paths but never binds the provenance to an authoritative suite contract.

failures.name: FOREIGN_MANIFEST_AUTHORITY_SUBSTITUTION
failures.observation: A heldout case was redirected to a repo-local foreign manifest declaring the same case_id as dev and became exportable.
failures.root_cause: Any repo-local manifest with matching family_id/case_id/path can become authority; suite membership is not verified.
